name: message
title: Message
description: A sender's run in a conversation, on one reading edge: the header (name, time), every bubble's text, the file glyphs and the receipt start on the same line. Consecutive bubbles stack on shared keylines; the avatar sits in the gutter level with the first bubble. align="end" is the reader's own run, at the end of the log, mirrored with the writing direction.
whenToUse: Use it to group one sender's consecutive messages with name, time and receipt on one edge. Put Bubble inside it, and Message scroller around the log.

props.name: align
props.description: start: the other party. end: the reader's own messages.

parts.name: MessageAvatar
parts.description: The avatar gutter. Put a size="md" Avatar in it (decorative when the header prints the name). The reader's own run leaves it out.

parts.name: MessageContent
parts.description: The run's column: header, bubbles, footers. It is as wide as its widest bubble, and everything in it hangs from the run's outer edge (start for theirs, end for yours).

parts.name: MessageFooter
parts.description: Delivery state of the bubble right above it ("Sent", "Read 14:22", "Not sent: no signal." + a Retry button), on the run's outer edge, in the Code voice.

props.name: tone
props.description: attention: the bubble above was not sent (the reason, then a Retry button).

parts.name: MessageGroup
parts.description: Runs one after another, one gutter and a half apart (a log's content is already one).

parts.name: MessageHeader
parts.description: Sender and time, over the bubbles' text inset on the run's outer edge: the name in the UI voice, the time in the Code voice (pass a <time>).
